Your reason of conversion should not be what other want, but should come from you. 

You and your partner should be connected and confident enough to each other so you can also show confidence to your kids. My kids know I’m not Jewish and they also know how to answer incase if some people ask them questions about their identity and or about me their mother. 

And like I commented earlier, my kids are not made to feel different. We live in the center.
